notes.title: 2025_4_8_Update
notes.content:
1.Added the function to skip the team competition. There will be a skip button after you select the team.

2.Temporarily removed the dynamic cloud save,but it will not affect the Steam cloud function. Now, the cloud save will be executed after closing the program, and there will be no sync during the game that may cause unexpected issues.

notes.title: v0.85a Update and the Planned Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Dear shopkeepers, it's been a long time![/h1]

[b]We sincerely thank you all for your active feedback on the game content all along. We truly value every single one of your suggestions. At present, although some of the feedback has not been implemented yet, our team is deeply discussing and making every effort to optimize them.[/b]

[h3][b]In this update, we have focused on the following optimizations:[/b][/h3]

[i]1. Logic of customers entering the bar counter: Now, customers will enter the bar counter in a more evenly random way, effectively avoiding the phenomenon of crowding together, and making the operation of the shop more reasonable and orderly.

2. Fast-forward logic of the storyline dialogues: The segmented way enables better clicking to fast-forward the storyline.

3. Balancing the numerical values of rewards for menu packages.

4. Prices of some commodities.

5. Slightly increase the rewards for manual production at the bar counter.[/i]

[h3][b]Next, we will reveal this year's update plan to you:[/b][/h3]

It is expected that we will launch the final chapter of the game at the end of this summer!

[i]1. More language support and optimization of translations.

2. The storyline of the final chapter will bring the whole story to an end.

3. New key characters and a new protagonist will be added.

4. New shop assistants and skills. A group of shop assistants with unique skills are eager to join your team.

5. Clothing and equipment: 14 brand-new pieces of clothing and equipment with various styles will be available soon, as well as new sets.

6. More buildings: Over 30 new buildings.

7. More customers: A large group of eccentric customers with distinct personalities are flocking to your shop.

8. New cards: As the core system of the game, the brand-new cards may instantly change the business situation.

9. Difficulty adjustment: We think the current difficulty is too easy. In order to make the game challenges more challenging and increase the strategic depth, we will slightly adjust the difficulty of obtaining gold coins, which will be increased by 10% - 20%.

10. A better tutorial process.[/i]
Yes, all the above update contents will be updated for free in the Early Access version, and there is no need to purchase additional DLCs! Since some of the adjustments and newly added contents involve the overall structural framework of the game, the contents will be released together after being tested and refined.

During this period, if you have any feedback or suggestions, you are welcome to leave a message in the discussion area or contact us directly via email. We will answer your questions one by one.

atricgame@gmail.com

notes.title: About can't save
notes.content:
We have encountered many such cases, and it is usually related to antivirus software.
For example, with the built-in RAV Endpoint Protection on the computer, you can resume saving operations normally after disabling the real-time protection feature of these programs.

Of course, any corrupted save files must be deleted; otherwise, the game will keep freezing. Please delete them from the Save Folder (for example, .tmp files and their corresponding save files). Be sure to keep cloud saves turned off to avoid syncing corrupted files.

#If you can't find the save path, please refer to the following#:

The part "C:\Users" varies depending on your computer's user name, so we recommend locating the folder using the following method:

Open Windows File Explorer.
Copy and paste the following into the address bar: %userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow
Press Enter, and you should see a folder named "AtricGames."
Open the "SkyBrew_Entropic Strategist\Saves" folder.

2024_10_23:
-------------------------
We have recently received feedback regarding issues related to .sav.tmp files. These files usually appear when game saves fail to sync properly with the Steam Cloud, which may lead to corrupted save files or black screen issues.

To prevent this from happening, please make sure to wait a few seconds after closing the game to ensure the Steam Cloud synchronization is completed. This can help avoid the creation of .sav.tmp files and ensure your save data remains intact.

If you already have a .sav.tmp file, please delete it. If you are still unable to load your save, please submit it to us, and we will help you repair it.

2024_10_22:
-------------------------
1. Added a [Cancel Takeover] feature in bar mode, allowing you to exit the bar operation at any time (if you choose to cancel the takeover, the order time will be calculated based on the staff's handling duration).
2. Removed the time calculation when entering the bar for the first time, and split the bar tutorial into multiple pages.
3. Fixed an issue where Set Combos were not displayed or applied correctly after removing the bar. (If your previous save had errors, using the one-click building removal feature will fully resolve the combo issues.)
4. Fixed an issue where players could not enter the workshop.

2024_10_21:
-------------------------
1. Fixed an issue where wall decorations were not correctly counted towards the style.
2. Fixed an issue where staff configurations would become disordered after deleting an operation room.
3. Known issue and being addressed: Reloading a save in-game may cause the [Building Combo] to not display properly. Temporary fix: Restart the program and then reload the save.

Regarding the black screen issue some players have encountered, our speculations are as follows:

1. It may be caused by old saves carrying over bugs from previous versions. Please send your save file to our email, and we will assist in fixing it.
2. It could be due to a Steam cloud sync interruption, causing corrupted saves. A characteristic of this is a file ending with .tmp in your save folder. You can also send this file to our email. (When closing the program, please wait about 2 seconds to ensure the sync completes.)
3. Whether it's the issues mentioned above or others (e.g., bar counter getting stuck), you can send your save file along with a brief description of the issue to our email, and we will quickly help you check and fix the save.

notes.title: 2024_10_12 : New Additions & Fixes
notes.content:
1. 【Auto Save】can now be turned off in the settings, which will shorten the time between the results screen and the map, and reduce the chance of black screens on some devices. (If you turn it off, please remember to manually save at important points.)

2. For the very rare issue where the loading icon remains in the bottom right corner, the temporary solution is to press ESC to forcibly hide the icon.

3. Two new counter operation shortcuts have been added: Start/Serve Meal【Space】, Oven【B】, and the associated animation prompts have been optimized.

4. A new resolution is now supported: 3840 x 1080.

For players experiencing black screen issues: we have analyzed some cases where the game gets stuck saving at the end screen, and recommend you try deleting the PlayerSetting_save file located in C:\Users\win\AppData\LocalLow\AtricGames\SkyBrew_Entropic Strategist\Saves (Don't worry, the program will automatically regenerate this file if it doesn't exist.) This file stores your settings save, and the issue may be related to resolution or windowed mode.

If you encounter issues with your save data, please describe the problem and send it to us at atricgame@gmail.com, and we will assist you as soon as possible.
